summary: AGI Inc filed a Form 6-K containing a routine first-quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing discusses operational results, client milestones, AI investments, and an organizational restructuring into business units. No specific special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, capital return, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is mentioned. The filing is an ordinary earnings report by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
